script: [serious] Three men vanished from America's most escape-proof prison — and left their own heads behind. June, nineteen sixty-two. Alcatraz. In three bunks, guards found sleeping men... made of soap, toilet paper and real hair. Frank Morris and the Anglin brothers dug through their vents with spoons, and launched a raft of over fifty raincoats. Searchers found something in the water: a paddle, and a sealed packet of family photos. Did they drown, or pack them planning to live? The FBI closed the case in nineteen seventy-nine. The U.S. Marshals never have. This is Dossier Decoded. Case file number eleven. Which file should we open next?
